incidents.name: AES deflationary transfer pair-balance flaw
incidents.notes: AES's deflationary transfer burns from the liquidity pair's own balance without a sync(), so the attacker shrank the AES reserve and swapped the resulting imbalance out for the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: AES 0xdDc0CFF76bcC0ee14c3e73aF630C029fe020F907 created 2022-12-06T14:38:44Z by 0x7c64e03e0a4ed9c19f1ab8b85b8e10ea59bbd150, unrelated to attack sender 0x286e09932b8d096cba3423d12965042736b8f850; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 61,608.04 USDT left the AES/USDT pair 0x40eD17221b3B2D8455F4F1a05CAc6b77c5f707e3 to the attacker.
